system.description:
You can cancel a boon that must be actively invoked. In addition, the target cannot benefit from or have the target boon invoked upon them for 1 minute.

Applied automatically when a boon is canceled through Nullify; the applied effect remembers the canceled boon (flags.openlegend.blocksBoon) and blocks it from being granted again while it runs.

effects.name: Nullify Boon Cancelation
effects.description: This boon has been canceled by Nullify: the bearer cannot benefit from it or have it invoked upon them again for 1 minute.
